description: This file contains Go source code for a utility generator in the Kubernetes code generation framework. It defines a generator for creating the ForKind() function, which maps GroupVersionKind to apply configuration types, including data structures for groups, versions, and resource configurations, as well as methods for generating code snippets.

classes.name: utilGenerator
classes.description: A generator struct that produces the ForKind() utility function and related code for applying configurations based on GroupVersionKind.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Ensures the generator generates the file exactly once.

methods.name: Namers
methods.description: Returns the naming strategies used by the generator.

methods.name: Imports
methods.description: Returns the list of import lines needed for the generated code.

methods.name: GenerateType
methods.description: Generates the main code for the ForKind() function and related helpers.
